title: Fake chemical smelling rubbery roses! Not real!
text:
Fake chemical smelling rubbery roses! Not real!. This company put in several places on their listing that these are real preserved roses but when I open the box, I'm hit with a disgusting chemical and rose smell. I pull a flower out and notice they're all made out of some cheap rubber. They look like cheapo dollar store fake roses. I'd truly be embarrassed to gift this to anyone and they stink so much that I threw them out. The earrings are sparkly and pretty. The necklace is cute.

This is seriously one of the worst things I've ever gotten from Amazon!
